name: Filen Desktop
description: macOS Squirrel.Mac (B), but package.json sets verifyUpdateCodeSignature:false on Windows and Linux has no verification — both fall back to a sha512 from the same CDN.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The Windows builder configuration sets verifyUpdateCodeSignature to false despite Azure signing settings. Linux verification, generated manifests, and the macOS framework's runtime enforcement remain unresolved.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot; this review did not audit generated latest files, released artifacts, Linux verification, or the external Squirrel/electron-updater implementation.
